findings.title: The concurrency test can pass without observing reader failures
findings.body: The reader thread is neither coordinated with the deletions nor joined before `caughtExceptions` is checked. Deletion can finish before the reader makes its first request, and if a request is still in flight when `deletedAll` is set, the assertion can run before that request records an exception. Consequently, this test can pass without exercising the race or while a failure from the final request is still pending.
